description: Read a statutory EU deadline by exact case-sensitive id from compliance_list_deadlines. Use that list for discovery, law/date filters or multiple deadlines. Returns as_of, verified and deadline with obligation, date, status, days_until, previous_date, source URL/quote/SHA-256 and dated history. Unknown ids return deadline_not_found. Legal data is bundled as of verified; days_until updates with the current date. Free keyless allowance: 100 successful answers/day when metered, unlimited otherwise. API keys retain their credit policy. No MCP payment flow; exhaustion returns the HTTP alternative.

id.description: Exact case-sensitive id from compliance_list_deadlines, 1 to 80 lowercase ASCII letters/digits/hyphens, e.g. eudr-large-medium-operators

name: compliance_get_deadline
title: Get one EU compliance deadline
